one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API with API-key Bearer auth; access is via a 60-day free trial (100 emails/day), and only community MCP servers were found.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys created in the console with scoped permissions; no OAuth documented.
access_notes: New accounts get a 60-day trial with 100 emails/day for Email API, no credit card required. After the trial, email send stops unless a paid plan is chosen.
blocker_notes: A 60-day trial is long enough to build and test. Customers use their own API keys. Vendor MCP status was not verifiable from the provided pages.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
The base URL for Web API v3 requests is `https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/` for global users and subusers, and `https://api.eu.sendgrid.com/v3/` for EU subusers.
users will be given a 60 day timed free trial plan.
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required
**Send up to 100 email messages via web API or SMTP per day**
SendGrid’s Event Webhook will notify a URL of your choice via HTTP POST with information about events that occur while SendGrid is processing your email.
